## Problem

Describe the problem you're trying to solve. What is frustrating about the current state?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions

Other approaches you've considered.

## ATS Platform (if applicable)

If this is about a specific job platform (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse), which one?

## Additional Context

Any mockups, screenshots, or links to similar features in other tools.

## Would you be willing to implement this?

- [ ] Yes, I can submit a PR
- [ ] Yes, with guidance from maintainers
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting it
